state_definition: L ARs, compounded raw return, mean turnover, mean log(volume), sample SD raw returns; no market cap or industry feature
scope: One nearest nonrecommended stock from all cached market stocks with complete observable pre-event core features
distance_tie_break: Ascending stock code; stable order on equal Mahalanobis distance

quality_revision.purpose: Remove the effective-N multiplier from q while preserving every event, fixed control, input, target, and training normalization scale
